description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - voice list: family fires five things to buy or bring at you on your way out and half are gone by the door. You repeat them in your own voice (host speech recognition, after a wearer-mode mic availability check); each heard item waits on a confirm chip - nothing joins the list unconfirmed - and the list is held as plain text on the glasses so it survives closing the agent. At the shop the list sits in your view: swipe to move, nod with your head steady to check the item you are looking at, Enter toggles. When exactly one item is left it is promoted huge and spoken once - the doorway reminder - and when all are checked it says so once. SPEAK reads only what is still missing.
name: voice-list
